notes: The agreement (Wayback 2016-03-27) runs 2014-07-01 to 2017-06-30 and continues in force under Art. 28.2 until a successor is ratified; read as in force on 2018-03-13 (version note).

The HR page is an undated summary captured 2016-07-01; it agrees with Art. 24.3 (eligibility, up to 18 months, 100% for two weeks, 90% SEB for 35 weeks, must be receiving EI) and adds no provision; no component relies on it.

Birth parent chain: maternity leave 18 (c1) -> parental leave 34 (c3) -> additional unpaid leave for the balance of 18 months (c4), all within the 78-week limit; pay: 100% salary weeks 1-2 (c5 within c1) -> SEB to 90% up to 35 weeks (c6 after c5); EI maternity 15 from week 2 (c7, offset 1 on c1) -> EI parental 35 (c8 after c7).

Non-birth parent chain: parental leave 37 (c3) -> additional unpaid leave to the 78-week limit (c4); pay: 100% salary weeks 1-2 (c5 within c3) -> SEB up to 35 weeks (c6 after c5); EI parental 35 from week 2 (c8 concurrent_with c3, offset 1).
Calendar: the agreement refers to semesters (fall and winter) without stating their length: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component is measured in terms.

Not components: court and personal-litigation leave (24.1), political office leave (24.5), education leave (23.1), retraining (5.9), sabbatical (16.7), gradual retirement (19.1.1.4): none can be taken for a birth. Art. 24.9 counts parental leave as service; the Dean arranges coverage of duties during the leave.
Cross-references not saved: the academic salary continuance plan (c17); the deferred salary leave plan regulations (c13); Faculty Criteria Documents (not about leave).
